statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (K : (Fin 4 → Fin n) → ℝ) (j : Fin 4 → Fin n) (p : Equiv.Perm (Fin 4)), (∀ j, 0 ≤ K j) → 0 ≤ 4*K (fun i => j (p i))
proof:
intro n K j p hK
exact mul_nonneg (by norm_num) (hK (fun i => j (p i)))
